summary: EdgeTech Academy announces a new companywide policy embracing online learning platforms and e-learning resources for employee professional development. It promises personalized, on-demand learning paths, named platform partners, perks and discounts, a recognition system, and community features. Employees can get started by contacting the Development Gurus.
one_line: EdgeTech Academy's new policy commits to online learning platforms like LinkedIn Learning, Coursera and Udemy, with perks, recognition, community features and Development Gurus support.
key_facts: EdgeTech Academy's new policy embraces online learning platforms and e-learning resources for professional development.
The policy is a companywide initiative to boost employees' professional development through online learning platforms.
EdgeTech Academy is partnering with e-learning resource providers to give employees access to knowledge.
Learning is interactive and on-demand, with personalized learning paths tailored to each employee.
Courses can be accessed anytime, anywhere, on any device.
The curated platform selection includes LinkedIn Learning, Coursera, and Udemy.
Example learning topics mentioned are coding and project management certification.
EdgeTech Academy offers perks and discounts across its online learning partner network.
EdgeTech Academy has a recognition system that celebrates employees' breakthroughs.
The online platforms have built-in community features so EdgeTechers can share tips, hacks, and success stories.
Employees who want to get started should reach out to the Development Gurus, who explain how to launch their e-learning.
The note describes the policy as a promise to keep employees ahead in an evolving digital landscape.
